from pathlib import Path
root=Path('managed_components/espressif__esp-zigbee-lib/include/ezbee')
needles=['ezb_zcl_set_attr_value_message_s','ezb_zcl_get_attr_value','ezb_zcl_ias_zone_enroll_req_cmd_s','EZB_ZCL_ATTR_IAS_ZONE_IAS_CIE_ADDRESS_ID','EZB_ZCL_ATTR_IAS_ZONE_ZONE_STATE_ID','EZB_ZCL_ATTR_IAS_ZONE_ZONE_ID_ID']
for p in sorted(root.rglob('*')):
    if not p.is_file(): continue
    lines=p.read_text(errors='ignore').splitlines()
    hits=[i for i,l in enumerate(lines) if any(n.lower() in l.lower() for n in needles)]
    if not hits: continue
    print('===',p,'===')
    spans=[]
    for i in hits:
        a=max(0,i-12); b=min(len(lines),i+34)
        if spans and a<=spans[-1][1]: spans[-1]=(spans[-1][0],max(spans[-1][1],b))
        else: spans.append((a,b))
    for a,b in spans:
        for j in range(a,b): print(f'{j+1:4d}: {lines[j]}')
        print()
